Roast asparagus with oil + salt at 425F / 220C for 12 min.
Season chicken breast with salt, pepper, garlic. Bake at 400F for 22 min. Rest 5 min before slicing.

dinners.note: While this cooks - prep both weekday lunch batches.

substitutions.note: Bake at 400F for 22 min, skip sear step
Bake at 400F for 14 min, skip sear step

ingredients.item: Dijon mustard, garlic, thyme, salt, pepper, lemon

steps: Cook lentils: simmer in salted water 20 min. Drain, dress with olive oil + lemon.
Rub pork with Dijon, garlic, thyme, salt + pepper. Sear 2 min per side.
Toss Brussels sprouts with oil, salt, pepper. Arrange around pork on the pan.
Roast at 410F / 210C for 18-20 min until pork hits 145F / 63C. Rest 5 min. Portion by weight.

jakeLunch.name: Turkish-Style Lentil + Chicken Bowl
jakeLunch.note: Make the full batch below, then divide into 5 equal containers. Grab one each day Mon–Fri. Reheat 2 min - add a splash of water to the lentils first.

ingredients.item: 2 cups dry red lentils (makes enough for 5 - do not reduce)
2 cans (15 oz each) black beans, drained
10 oz / about 8 big handfuls fresh spinach
2 tsp cumin, 2 tsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp turmeric

steps: Season ALL the chicken with cumin, paprika, salt + pepper. Bake at 400F / 200C for 25 min. Cool and shred the whole batch - this is the protein for all 5 containers.
Rinse ALL the lentils. Simmer in 3.5 cups (900ml) water with turmeric + crushed garlic for 15 min until soft. They thicken as they cool - this is normal. This is the base for all 5.
In a large pan, saute ALL the zucchini in olive oil 5 min. Add ALL the black beans, warm through. Add ALL the spinach, toss until wilted.
Now divide: split everything evenly across 5 containers - lentils on the bottom, the veggie/bean mix in the middle, shredded chicken on top.
Squeeze lemon over each container. Pack Greek yogurt separately if using - mix in right before eating. Done for the week.

laineLunch.name: Chicken, Rice + Roasted Veggie Bowl
laineLunch.note: Make the full batch below, then divide into 5 equal containers. Higher carb, lower fat to match Laine's macros. Keeps all week in the fridge.

ingredients.item: 1.5 cups dry basmati or jasmine rice (cook the whole batch - this is for all 5 containers)
1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp garlic powder, paprika, salt

steps: Cook ALL the rice per package. Fluff and season lightly with salt. This batch is the base for all 5 containers.
Season ALL the chicken breast with spices. Bake at 400F / 200C for 22 min. Cool and slice the whole batch.
Toss ALL the zucchini, cherry tomatoes, red onion, and chickpeas with olive oil + salt on a sheet pan. Roast at 410F / 210C for 20 min.
Now divide: split everything evenly across 5 containers - rice on the bottom, roasted veggie mix in the middle, sliced chicken on top.
Squeeze lemon over each container, top with parsley. Seal and refrigerate. Done for the week.

steps: Layer yogurt in a bowl or jar.
Top with berries, granola, flaxseed, and a drizzle of honey.

laineBreakfasts.name: Egg White Scramble + Toast
steps: Saute bell pepper in olive oil 2 min. Add spinach, wilt 1 min.
Add eggs. Scramble gently over medium-low heat until just set.
Serve with toast.

laineBreakfasts.name: Banana Oat Protein Pancakes
steps: Blend banana, oats, eggs, protein powder, and cinnamon until smooth.
Cook small pancakes on a non-stick pan over medium heat, 2 min per side.
Top with fresh fruit and a drizzle of honey.
